items.title: Don't Marry an AI — Zarna Blog
items.summary: Partners keep asking me which AI they should buy, but the answer now changes faster than a firm can act on it. The best model can launch, disappear three days later, return under new limits, and face a new competitor before anyone has finished deciding what to do with it.

items.title: Why Chatbots Aren't Enough in PE — Zarna Blog
items.summary: A chatbot can summarize a CIM in seconds, but the associate still carries the screen, the CRM history, the read on the banker, the prior theses, and every step that follows. The firms that pull ahead won't have the best chat window. They'll have AI that works like a colleague inside the deal flow.

items.title: Day in the Life of a PE Firm Running on Zarna — Zarna Blog
items.summary: A $10M dermatology platform looked like an easy pass. Then Zarna cross-referenced it against the firm's portfolio, an old portco call note, a January board deck, and a months-old Teams message, and surfaced the add-on fit the standalone screen had missed.
